description: NaVCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.79 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.04 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and two longer (1.33 Å) C-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-40°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom.
